title: Reported speech
objectives: I can report statements, questions and commands accurately, with the correct shift of tenses.
I can choose among reporting verbs such as afirmar, declarar, sugerir, prometer, negar, avisar, pedir and mandar.
I can change pronouns and references to time and place when I report what someone said.
I can tell the difference between formal reported speech and the colloquial pattern ele falou que vem.
I can summarize conversations, interviews and meetings in speech and in writing.

example.pt: O ministro afirmou que os números estavam corretos.
example.en: The minister stated that the figures were correct.

example.pt: A empresa declarou que não tinha conhecimento do problema.
example.en: The company declared that it was not aware of the problem.

vocabulary.note: Followed by que and the subjunctive: sugeriu que fôssemos.

example.pt: Ela sugeriu que a gente mudasse o horário da reunião.
example.en: She suggested that we change the meeting time.

example.pt: Ele prometeu que chegaria antes das oito.
example.en: He promised that he would arrive before eight.

vocabulary.note: Followed by que and the subjunctive when it means to deny: negou que soubesse.

example.pt: O jogador negou que tivesse brigado com o técnico.
example.en: The player denied that he had argued with the coach.

vocabulary.en: to warn, to let someone know

example.pt: A companhia aérea avisou que o voo sairia com atraso.
example.en: The airline announced that the flight would leave late.

example.pt: O gerente garantiu que o pedido chegaria na quinta-feira.
example.en: The manager assured us that the order would arrive on Thursday.

example.pt: Ela admitiu que tinha cometido um erro.
example.en: She admitted that she had made a mistake.

example.pt: O porta-voz acrescentou que haveria uma nova coletiva.
example.en: The spokesperson added that there would be another press conference.

example.pt: O artista revelou que estava escrevendo um livro.
example.en: The artist revealed that he was writing a book.

vocabulary.note: Insistir que, or insistir em plus infinitive.

example.pt: Ele insistiu que não tinha nada a ver com o caso.
example.en: He insisted that he had nothing to do with the matter.

example.pt: Os clientes reclamaram que o atendimento era lento.
example.en: The customers complained that the service was slow.

vocabulary.note: The feminine is a entrevistada; the person asking is o entrevistador.

example.pt: O entrevistado respondeu com calma a todas as perguntas.
example.en: The interviewee answered all the questions calmly.

vocabulary.note: Feminine: a porta-voz. The plural is os porta-vozes.

example.pt: O porta-voz do clube negou as acusações.
example.en: The club's spokesperson denied the accusations.

example.pt: A coletiva de imprensa começou com meia hora de atraso.
example.en: The press conference began half an hour late.

vocabulary.en: testimony, statement (to the police or court)

example.pt: A testemunha prestou depoimento na delegacia.
example.en: The witness gave a statement at the police station.

example.pt: O jornal não revelou a fonte da informação.
example.en: The newspaper did not reveal the source of the information.

example.pt: Cada testemunha contou uma versão diferente dos fatos.
example.en: Each witness told a different version of the facts.

example.pt: Correu um boato de que a fábrica ia fechar.
example.en: A rumor went around that the factory was going to close.

vocabulary.note: A person who gossips is a fofoqueiro or fofoqueira.

example.pt: Não gosto de fofoca no ambiente de trabalho.
example.en: I don't like gossip in the workplace.

vocabulary.note: Deixar um recado means to leave a message.

example.pt: Deixei um recado com a secretária, mas ninguém ligou.
example.en: I left a message with the secretary, but nobody called.

example.pt: Ela repassou a informação para toda a equipe.
example.en: She passed the information on to the whole team.

example.pt: Meu chefe comentou que estava satisfeito com o resultado.
example.en: My boss mentioned that he was satisfied with the result.

example.pt: Pode resumir em poucas palavras o que ele disse?
example.en: Can you summarize what he said in a few words?

example.pt: A ata da reunião será enviada por e-mail.
example.en: The minutes of the meeting will be sent by email.

vocabulary.note: In journalism, a pauta is the list of stories to cover.

example.pt: O primeiro item da pauta é o orçamento do próximo ano.
example.en: The first item on the agenda is next year's budget.

vocabulary.en: follow-up action, decision passed on for action

example.pt: O encaminhamento da reunião foi contratar dois novos analistas.
example.en: The outcome of the meeting was to hire two new analysts.

example.pt: A secretária registrou tudo o que foi decidido.
example.en: The secretary recorded everything that was decided.

example.pt: Segundo a prefeitura, as obras terminam em março.
example.en: According to city hall, the works end in March.

example.pt: De acordo com a ata, a proposta foi aprovada por unanimidade.
example.en: According to the minutes, the proposal was approved unanimously.

example.pt: Ela disse que tinha viajado na véspera.
example.en: She said she had traveled the day before.

example.pt: Ele prometeu que voltaria no dia seguinte.
example.en: He promised he would come back the next day.

dialogues.title: Office grapevine
dialogues.context: At the office, Priscila, Marcos and Elaine are passing on a rumor and arguing about exactly what was said.

lines.speaker: Priscila
lines.pt: Marcos, você não sabe o que a Elaine me contou hoje de manhã!
lines.en: Marcos, you won't believe what Elaine told me this morning!

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: O que foi? Conta logo!
lines.en: What is it? Tell me already!

lines.speaker: Priscila
lines.pt: Ela disse que o Rodrigo ia pedir demissão no fim do mês.
lines.en: She said that Rodrigo was going to resign at the end of the month.

lines.speaker: Elaine
lines.pt: Calma, Priscila, eu não falei exatamente isso. Eu disse que tinha ouvido dizer que ele estava procurando outro emprego.
lines.en: Calm down, Priscila, I didn't say exactly that. I said I had heard that he was looking for another job.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Ouvir dizer é diferente de ter certeza, né? Quem te falou isso?
lines.en: Hearing something is different from being sure, right? Who told you that?

lines.speaker: Elaine
lines.pt: A Letícia, do financeiro. Ela contou que viu o currículo dele na impressora.
lines.en: Letícia, from finance. She said she saw his CV on the printer.

lines.speaker: Priscila
lines.pt: Então pode ser verdade. Ontem ele me perguntou se eu conhecia alguém numa empresa de tecnologia.
lines.en: Then it might be true. Yesterday he asked me if I knew anyone at a technology company.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Hum, aí fica estranho mesmo. Mas semana passada eu perguntei se estava tudo bem, e ele respondeu que estava ótimo.
lines.en: Hmm, now it does get strange. But last week I asked if everything was fine, and he answered that he was great.

lines.speaker: Elaine
lines.pt: As pessoas nem sempre falam a verdade, Marcos. E o chefe, será que já sabe?
lines.en: People don't always tell the truth, Marcos. And the boss, does he know already?

lines.speaker: Priscila
lines.pt: Não sei. Mas eu prometi pra Letícia que não ia contar pra ninguém. Opa.
lines.en: I don't know. But I promised Letícia that I wouldn't tell anyone. Oops.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Pois é, agora você já contou pra todo mundo.
lines.en: Well, now you've told everyone.

lines.speaker: Elaine
lines.pt: Vamos combinar uma coisa: ninguém repassa isso até a gente ter certeza.
lines.en: Let's agree on one thing: nobody passes this on until we are sure.

dialogues.title: Writing the minutes
dialogues.context: Helena, the secretary, checks with the director, Seu Antônio, and with Vera how to record what was said at yesterday's meeting.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.pt: Seu Antônio, estou escrevendo a ata da reunião de ontem. Posso confirmar alguns pontos?
lines.en: Seu Antônio, I'm writing the minutes of yesterday's meeting. May I confirm a few points?

lines.speaker: Antônio
lines.pt: Claro, Helena. Pode perguntar.
lines.en: Of course, Helena. Go ahead.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.pt: Logo no início, o senhor declarou que a empresa tinha atingido a meta do trimestre, correto?
lines.en: Right at the start, you declared that the company had reached the quarter's target, correct?

lines.speaker: Antônio
lines.pt: Isso. Eu afirmei que vendemos dez por cento acima do previsto.
lines.en: That's right. I stated that we sold ten percent above the forecast.

lines.speaker: Vera
lines.pt: E eu sugeri que o prazo do novo projeto fosse estendido por duas semanas, lembra?
lines.en: And I suggested that the deadline for the new project be extended by two weeks, remember?

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.pt: Lembro, Vera. Vou registrar que você sugeriu a extensão. E o senhor respondeu que ia analisar a proposta.
lines.en: I remember, Vera. I'll record that you suggested the extension. And you answered that you would look at the proposal.

lines.speaker: Antônio
lines.pt: Exato. Pode escrever que eu prometi dar uma resposta até sexta-feira.
lines.en: Exactly. You can write that I promised to give an answer by Friday.

lines.speaker: Vera
lines.pt: E o encaminhamento sobre a contratação? O Jorge perguntou se haveria vagas no próximo semestre.
lines.en: And the follow-up on hiring? Jorge asked whether there would be openings next semester.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.pt: Isso. E o senhor disse que a decisão dependeria do orçamento.
lines.en: Yes. And you said that the decision would depend on the budget.

lines.speaker: Antônio
lines.pt: Correto. Coloque também que eu pedi que todos enviassem os relatórios até quinta-feira.
lines.en: Correct. Also put that I asked everyone to send their reports by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.pt: Certo. Vou mandar a ata hoje à tarde para todos os participantes.
lines.en: Right. I'll send the minutes to all participants this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Vera
lines.pt: Ótimo. Se alguém reclamar que não foi citado, eu aviso que a ata segue a ordem da pauta.
lines.en: Great. If anyone complains that they weren't quoted, I'll point out that the minutes follow the order of the agenda.

dialogues.title: What the chef said on the radio
dialogues.context: Davi heard a radio interview with a famous chef and now retells it to his friends Sofia and Nando.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.pt: Davi, você estava ouvindo rádio ontem, né? O que a chef Luíza disse na entrevista?
lines.en: Davi, you were listening to the radio yesterday, right? What did chef Luíza say in the interview?

lines.speaker: Davi
lines.pt: Disse muita coisa! Primeiro, ela contou que tinha crescido num restaurante de família em Minas.
lines.en: She said a lot! First, she told us she had grown up in a family restaurant in Minas.

lines.speaker: Nando
lines.pt: E por que ela saiu de lá?
lines.en: And why did she leave?

lines.speaker: Davi
lines.pt: Explicou que queria conhecer outras cozinhas, então foi morar na Itália por três anos.
lines.en: She explained that she wanted to get to know other cuisines, so she went to live in Italy for three years.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.pt: Que legal. E agora, o que ela vai fazer?
lines.en: How nice. And now, what is she going to do?

lines.speaker: Davi
lines.pt: Revelou que abriria um restaurante novo em São Paulo no mês seguinte e garantiu que o cardápio teria pratos de todas as regiões.
lines.en: She revealed that she would open a new restaurant in São Paulo the following month and assured us the menu would have dishes from every region.

lines.speaker: Nando
lines.pt: Ela falou o preço? Esses lugares costumam ser caros.
lines.en: Did she mention the price? Those places tend to be expensive.

lines.speaker: Davi
lines.pt: O entrevistador perguntou isso, e ela respondeu que os preços seriam justos. Insistiu que queria um restaurante para todo mundo.
lines.en: The interviewer asked that, and she answered that prices would be fair. She insisted that she wanted a restaurant for everyone.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.pt: Será? Li uma reportagem em que ela reclamava dos custos.
lines.en: Really? I read a report in which she complained about costs.

lines.speaker: Davi
lines.pt: Ela admitiu que os custos estavam altos, mas acrescentou que não ia aumentar o preço dos pratos.
lines.en: She admitted that costs were high, but added that she wasn't going to raise the price of the dishes.

lines.speaker: Nando
lines.pt: Então vamos tentar quando abrir. Você lembra a data?
lines.en: Then let's try it when it opens. Do you remember the date?

lines.speaker: Davi
lines.pt: Lembro, ela disse que a inauguração seria no dia vinte e pediu que o pessoal fizesse reserva com antecedência.
lines.en: I do, she said the opening would be on the twentieth and asked people to make reservations in advance.

grammar.title: Tense backshift in reported speech
grammar.explanation:
When the reporting verb is in a past tense (disse, perguntou, contou), formal Portuguese moves every tense of the original words one step back in time. This is called backshift. The present becomes the imperfect (Estou cansado becomes Ele disse que estava cansado). The preterite becomes the pluperfect (Fui ao médico becomes Ela disse que tinha ido ao médico; the simple form fora is literary). The future becomes the conditional (Chegarei cedo becomes Ele disse que chegaria cedo, or that ia chegar). The imperfect normally stays as it is.

The subjunctive shifts too: the present subjunctive becomes the imperfect subjunctive (Espero que você venha becomes Ela disse que esperava que eu viesse), and the future subjunctive becomes the imperfect subjunctive (Quando eu chegar becomes Ele disse que, quando chegasse...). An imperative becomes the imperfect subjunctive after pedir que or mandar que: Espere aqui! becomes Ela pediu que eu esperasse ali.

If the reporting verb is in the present (Ela diz que..., Ele está dizendo que...) or in the present perfect, nothing shifts: Ela diz que está cansada. Nothing shifts either if the statement is still true and the speaker wants to stress it: Ele disse que a reunião é amanhã.

rows: Disse que tinha comprado um carro.
Disse que ia viajar no dia seguinte.
Disse que esperava que eu viesse.

examples.pt: Ela afirmou que estava trabalhando desde as seis da manhã.
examples.en: She stated that she had been working since six in the morning.

examples.pt: O gerente disse que já tinha enviado o relatório.
examples.en: The manager said he had already sent the report.

examples.pt: Ele avisou que o voo sairia com atraso.
examples.en: He warned that the flight would leave late.

examples.pt: Eles contaram que, quando chegassem ao hotel, ligariam para a família.
examples.en: They said that when they arrived at the hotel, they would call the family.

examples.pt: Ela perguntou quem tinha deixado a porta aberta.
examples.en: She asked who had left the door open.

grammar.title: Reporting verbs and their constructions
grammar.explanation:
The neutral reporting verbs are dizer que, falar que, and contar que. More precise verbs show what kind of speech act it was. Afirmar and declarar report a formal or firm statement, acrescentar adds something, explicar gives a reason, responder answers, reclamar reports a complaint, garantir and prometer commit the speaker, admitir and confessar report an admission, negar reports a denial, and avisar warns.

Each verb has its own pattern. Prometer and garantir can take que plus the indicative or conditional (Prometeu que voltaria), or an infinitive with the same subject (Prometeu voltar). Negar takes an infinitive with the same subject (Negou ter dito isso) or que plus the subjunctive. Sugerir, pedir and exigir take que plus the imperfect subjunctive (Sugeriu que fôssemos; Pediu que esperássemos). Negar que also requires the subjunctive, usually the imperfect or the pluperfect subjunctive (Negou que soubesse). Mandar means to order and is followed by an infinitive or que plus the subjunctive: Mandou a gente sair, Mandou que saíssemos.

For questions, use perguntar se for yes or no questions and keep the question word in open questions: Perguntou se eu queria ir, Perguntou onde eu morava. Querer saber (to want to know) is a common alternative: Quis saber quando o resultado sairia.

examples.pt: O presidente declarou que a situação estava sob controle.
examples.en: The president declared that the situation was under control.

examples.pt: Ele negou ter participado da reunião.
examples.en: He denied having taken part in the meeting.

examples.pt: Minha chefe sugeriu que eu fizesse um curso de inglês.
examples.en: My boss suggested that I take an English course.

examples.pt: O policial mandou o motorista parar o carro.
examples.en: The police officer ordered the driver to stop the car.

examples.pt: Ela quis saber se o voo já tinha chegado.
examples.en: She wanted to know whether the flight had already arrived.

grammar.title: Indirect questions, pronouns and time and place references
grammar.explanation:
In reported speech, the words that depend on the position of the speaker change. First and second person pronouns and possessives change according to who is reporting: Ela disse: Eu te amo becomes Ela disse que me amava (if she said it to me), or Ela disse que o amava. Possessives shift as well: meu carro becomes o carro dele or o carro dela.

Time words shift when the reporting happens at a different moment: hoje becomes naquele dia, ontem becomes na véspera or no dia anterior, amanhã becomes no dia seguinte, agora becomes naquele momento or então, semana que vem becomes na semana seguinte, and há três dias becomes três dias antes. Place words change too: aqui becomes ali or lá, and este becomes aquele. If the report is made on the same day, you can keep the original words: Ele disse que vem amanhã.

Indirect questions use se for yes or no questions and keep the question word otherwise, but the word order becomes that of a statement, without inversion: Onde você mora? becomes Ela perguntou onde eu morava. There is no question mark in the reported version. In everyday speech, Brazilians often use the simple present or imperfect without any shift of time references.

examples.pt: Ele disse: Vou te ligar amanhã. Ele disse que ia me ligar no dia seguinte.
examples.en: He said: I'll call you tomorrow. He said he would call me the next day.

examples.pt: Ela perguntou se eu tinha visto o filme na véspera.
examples.en: She asked whether I had seen the film the day before.

examples.pt: O guia explicou que aquele prédio era o mais antigo da cidade.
examples.en: The guide explained that that building was the oldest in the city.

examples.pt: Ela quis saber onde ficava a estação.
examples.en: She wanted to know where the station was.

examples.pt: Eles contaram que estavam ali desde o dia anterior.
examples.en: They said they had been there since the day before.

grammar.title: Formal backshift versus the colloquial present
grammar.explanation:
The careful backshift shown above is the rule in journalism, reports, minutes and formal speech. In everyday Brazilian conversation, people are much less strict. They usually keep the original tense, especially when the event is recent or still relevant: Ele falou que vem amanhã, Ela disse que tá cansada, O chefe avisou que a reunião é às dez. Nobody will consider this incorrect in speech, and using a formal backshift in casual chat can sound stiff.

In storytelling, Brazilians often skip reporting verbs entirely and quote with aí ele falou, aí eu falei, or just aí ele: não vou. Falar que is the most frequent reporting construction in speech, more than dizer que. In requests, pedir pra gente plus infinitive replaces the subjunctive: Ela pediu pra gente esperar. The imperfect subjunctive in requests (pediu que esperássemos) is standard in writing and in formal speech, but rarer in casual conversation.

As an advanced learner, aim to control both registers. Use the backshift when writing an email that summarizes a meeting or when speaking formally; use the lighter forms with friends. Remember that the reporting verb in the present (ele diz que) never requires a change of tense.

rows: Disse que viria no dia seguinte.
Informou que a reunião tinha sido cancelada.

examples.pt: Minha mãe falou que vem jantar aqui amanhã.
examples.en: My mom said she's coming to dinner here tomorrow.

examples.pt: Aí ele falou que não ia mais e saiu.
examples.en: Then he said he wasn't going anymore and left.

examples.pt: O chefe avisou que amanhã ninguém trabalha.
examples.en: The boss said that nobody works tomorrow.

examples.pt: Ela pediu pra gente chegar mais cedo.
examples.en: She asked us to arrive earlier.

examples.pt: O relatório informa que as vendas cresceram no último trimestre.
examples.en: The report states that sales grew in the last quarter.

culture.title: Disse me disse, rádio corredor e áudios do WhatsApp
culture.text:
Brazilians have a vivid vocabulary for passing on information. A fofoca is gossip, and the expression disse me disse (literally, said told me) describes the tangle of versions that follows any rumor. In offices, the informal network of rumors is called rádio corredor, radio hallway. The children's game that English speakers call telephone is telefone sem fio, and it is the standard image for how a message changes as it passes from person to person.

In daily life, reporting is often delivered in the middle of a long story. Brazilians love to tell what happened in detail, recreating dialogues with aí ele falou, aí eu falei. On messaging apps, people send long voice messages, called áudios, and later summarize them for others: A Carla mandou um áudio dizendo que vai atrasar. It is common to ask Me resume o áudio? when a message is too long to listen to. Learning to summarize is therefore a practical skill, not only an academic one.

In the press and in official life, reported speech follows strict conventions. Newspapers use segundo, de acordo com and fontes to attribute statements, and many headlines put the verb in the present: Ministro diz que vai aumentar o imposto. Companies and public bodies record meetings in an ata, written in the third person and in the past: O diretor declarou que..., A secretária sugeriu que... If you work in Brazil, you will probably read, and sometimes write, such a text.

readings.title: Prefeitura anuncia novo horário do metrô

paragraphs.pt: O secretário de Transportes declarou na terça-feira que o metrô passaria a funcionar vinte e quatro horas nos fins de semana a partir de janeiro.
paragraphs.en: The Transportation Secretary declared on Tuesday that the subway would start running twenty-four hours on weekends starting in January.

paragraphs.pt: Em entrevista coletiva, ele afirmou que a medida havia sido estudada durante dois anos e garantiu que a segurança dos passageiros seria reforçada.
paragraphs.en: At a press conference, he stated that the measure had been studied for two years and assured that passenger safety would be strengthened.

paragraphs.pt: Perguntado se o preço da passagem aumentaria, o secretário negou que houvesse qualquer plano nesse sentido. Segundo ele, o custo seria coberto pelo orçamento da prefeitura.
paragraphs.en: Asked whether the fare would go up, the secretary denied that there was any plan to do so. According to him, the cost would be covered by the city budget.

paragraphs.pt: Uma jornalista quis saber quando as obras nas estações terminariam. O secretário respondeu que a última estação ficaria pronta em dezembro, mas reconheceu que poderia haver atrasos.
paragraphs.en: A journalist wanted to know when the works at the stations would finish. The secretary answered that the last station would be ready in December, but acknowledged that there could be delays.

paragraphs.pt: Representantes dos moradores reclamaram que não tinham sido consultados. Eles sugeriram que a prefeitura realizasse uma audiência pública antes de aprovar a mudança.
paragraphs.en: Residents' representatives complained that they had not been consulted. They suggested that the city hall hold a public hearing before approving the change.

paragraphs.pt: O secretário prometeu convocar a audiência ainda este mês e acrescentou que todas as sugestões seriam analisadas. Pediu, porém, que os moradores tivessem paciência durante as obras.
paragraphs.en: The secretary promised to call the hearing this month and added that all suggestions would be considered. He asked, however, that residents be patient during the works.

paragraphs.pt: Um porta-voz da empresa que opera o metrô informou que os trens passariam por uma revisão completa. Disse também que novos funcionários seriam contratados para o período noturno.
paragraphs.en: A spokesperson for the company that operates the subway said the trains would go through a complete overhaul. He also said that new employees would be hired for the night shift.

paragraphs.pt: Até o fechamento desta edição, a prefeitura ainda não havia divulgado a data exata do início do novo horário.
paragraphs.en: By the time this edition went to press, the city hall had not yet released the exact start date of the new schedule.

choices: The subway would close on weekends
The subway would run twenty-four hours on weekends from January
The subway would be free in January
The subway would get new lines by December
questions.explanation: The first paragraph: o metrô passaria a funcionar vinte e quatro horas nos fins de semana.

questions.prompt: What did the secretary say about ticket prices?
choices: They would go up next year
There was no plan to raise them
They would be free on weekends
questions.explanation: He negou que houvesse qualquer plano nesse sentido.

questions.prompt: What did the residents' representatives suggest?
choices: A public hearing before approving the change
questions.explanation: They sugeriram que a prefeitura realizasse uma audiência pública.

choices: To finish all works in a month
To hold the public hearing this month
To resign if there were delays
questions.explanation: He prometeu convocar a audiência ainda este mês.

paragraphs.pt: Na sexta-feira passada, dona Célia pediu para a filha avisar o irmão de que o almoço de domingo seria às duas da tarde, e não à noite, como no mês anterior.
paragraphs.en: Last Friday, dona Célia asked her daughter to tell her brother that Sunday's lunch would be at two in the afternoon, and not in the evening, as the previous month.

paragraphs.pt: A filha, a Renata, estava no trânsito e mandou um áudio para o irmão dizendo que a mãe tinha falado que o almoço era às duas. Havia muito barulho de buzina ao fundo.
paragraphs.en: The daughter, Renata, was in traffic and sent her brother a voice message saying that their mother had said that the lunch was at two. There was a lot of honking in the background.

paragraphs.pt: O irmão, o Paulo, só ouviu o áudio à noite e entendeu que o almoço seria às três. Comentou com a esposa que a mãe tinha marcado para as três, e ela disse que faria uma sobremesa.
paragraphs.en: The brother, Paulo, only listened to the message at night and understood that lunch would be at three. He mentioned to his wife that their mother had set it for three, and she said she would make a dessert.

paragraphs.pt: No domingo, Paulo chegou à casa da mãe às três e encontrou todo mundo já à mesa. A mãe perguntou por que ele tinha se atrasado, e ele respondeu que a Renata avisara que seria às três.
paragraphs.en: On Sunday, Paulo arrived at his mother's house at three and found everybody already at the table. His mother asked why he was late, and he answered that Renata had told him it would be at three.

paragraphs.pt: A Renata jurou que tinha dito duas horas. Ela ouviu o áudio no celular do irmão, e todos reconheceram que a palavra podia mesmo ser confundida por causa do barulho.
paragraphs.en: Renata swore that she had said two o'clock. She listened to the message on her brother's phone, and everyone admitted that the word could really be mistaken because of the noise.

paragraphs.pt: Dona Célia riu e falou que, da próxima vez, ia ligar ela mesma. Paulo prometeu que daria mais atenção aos recados, e todos concordaram que a sobremesa chegou na hora certa.
paragraphs.en: Dona Célia laughed and said that next time she would call herself. Paulo promised that he would pay more attention to messages, and everyone agreed that the dessert arrived at exactly the right time.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct reported version of: Ele disse: 'Estou cansado.'
exercises.explanation: After a past reporting verb, the present shifts to the imperfect.

exercises.prompt: Complete in formal reported speech: Ela disse que ia viajar ___.
exercises.explanation: Formal reported speech replaces amanhã with no dia seguinte.

exercises.prompt: Which verb best reports 'Eu volto logo, prometo'?
exercises.explanation: Prometer reports a promise: Prometeu que voltaria logo.

exercises.prompt: Pedro said: 'Feche a porta!' Complete: Pedro pediu que eu ___ a porta.
exercises.explanation: Pedir que requires the imperfect subjunctive when the request is in the past.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence sounds most natural in casual conversation?
choices: Ela declarara que viria no dia seguinte.
Ela afirmou haver dito que viria no dia seguinte.
Ela disse que viesse no dia seguinte.
exercises.explanation: In speech, Brazilians often keep the present after falou que.

exercises.prompt: What does 'segundo' mean in 'Segundo o diretor, o prazo acabou'?
exercises.explanation: Segundo plus a person or source attributes information.

exercises.prompt_pt: Ela contou que ___ morando em Recife.

exercises.hint_en: He denied having read the message.

exercises.prompt_pt: A diretora sugeriu que todos ___ mais cedo.

exercises.hint_en: He promised he would arrive on time.
